entities.summary: Roger Grimau Gragera is a Spanish professional basketball coach and former player. He is the current head coach of Bursaspor Basketbol of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL). During his playing days, he was a 1.96 m tall swingman, that could also play as a point guard.
